title: docs(skills): data and automation skills teach three data-model publish checks
body:

_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3zQ2AqeghSGpv6Q7VEPDyQ)_

Fixes #37529

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:照技能文档让 AI 助手建数据模型的人,以后助手会提前知道三条发布检查:汇总字段的子对象必须有指回父对象的关联字段;关联目标只能写在关联类字段上;审批锁只锁主从明细行,用查找关系画进记录正文的明细表在审批期间仍然可改。以前文档没写,助手会写出发布时被拒的内容。
- 为什么做:属于「发布前拦住存得进去却不起作用的数据模型」这批工作的配套文档;检查已经上线,技能文档要跟上。
- 出错会怎样:只改技能文字和评测用例,不动产品。三个文件余量都只有几个词,新增的句子靠同一文件里把说法写短换来,没有删掉事实;写错直接撤回即可。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

One sentence per rule, each worded from the code on `main` at `fbcfdfbb58` (the lint rules PR #37513 landed), not from the card's paraphrase:

- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/relationships.md` (Roll-up Summaries): a roll-up is refused at publish when `relationshipField` is omitted and the child has no `lookup` / `master_detail` referencing the parent, or when `relationshipField` names no field of the child (`rollup/child-without-parent-reference`). Both arms are in the rule (`summaryRollupFindings`, severity `error`).
- `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md` (Relational): only `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` and `tree` read `reference`; on any other type but `summary`, publish refuses it (`field/reference-on-non-reference-type`, severity `error`). The card says `summary` reads it; the code says the four types read it and `summary` is exempt from the refusal, so the sentence says that.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md` (Approval Best Practices, item 2): `lockRecord` locks the record and its `master_detail` child rows only; a `lookup` child shown in the record's details (`relatedList: 'primary'`, or a parent field group, as the data skill names it) stays editable, reported as the warning `approval-detail-editable-while-pending`. It is taught as a warning, not a refusal.
- Evals: data case 12 (roll-up counts) now says the child has no field pointing at the parent (`project`, named in the prompt) and expects `reference: 'project'`; a new data case 29 asks about `reference` on a `text` field and requires the rule id `field/reference-on-non-reference-type`; automation case 3 (budget approval) now carries a lookup body table and expects `master_detail`.
- One `@objectstack/skills` patch changeset.

### Token ratchet: no ceiling moved

Every addition is paid for by shorter wording in the same file (`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, exit 0 at `4695c42cc6`).

## Tests

- Skill evals: NOT MEASURED, reason: no model runner in this container. The three touched cases are graded by nothing here.
- Eval tokens: checked by hand. `node ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs` exits 0 but walks `skills/objectui` only, so it says nothing about these fixtures (contract review 7204561928). On `4695c42cc6` every `must_contain` token of each data case is in its own reference answer and no `must_not_contain` token is (29 cases, 0 violations).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-examples`: exit 0, "352 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)".
- `node ui/scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs`: exit 0, "Every marked skill example holds up against the built types."

The two example gates were read at `ad8cf055c2`; the delta at `4695c42cc6` changes no code example. At `4695c42cc6`: token ratchet exit 0, `pnpm check:skill-links` exit 0, `check:skill-identifier-liveness` exit 0, `check:skill-frame-sync` exit 0; `check:doc-authoring` NOT MEASURED locally (exit 3, no `typescript` in the worktree), CI's.

## Acceptance notes

- Wording shortened to pay for the new sentences, no fact removed. relationships.md: "Supported via `summary`" becomes "Via `summary`" (two table cells); the recompute sentence drops "so it's consistent". field-types.md: nine table cells and two prose phrases lose filler words ("built-in format validation" to "format validated", "Video files" to "Video", and the like). state-machines-and-approvals.md: a code comment, the send-back opening sentence and two lead-ins are shorter.
- One nuance went: best practice 2 no longer says "unless you have a strong reason to allow edits while pending". It still says to keep the lock and why.
- After the review delta (7204561928 S1, N1 to N3): the roll-up sentence says the refusal applies only when `relationshipField` is omitted; the approval sentence uses the data skill's words for the table; data case 29 requires the rule id; case 12's prompt names `project`. Paid down in the same files: best practice 1 is shorter, and the `lockRecord` config row reads "Lock the record while pending" (best practice 2 says what the lock covers). state-machines-and-approvals.md now sits at zero headroom, relationships.md at 2.
- Draft PR #36158 edits the same three files. `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` reports it merges cleanly against this branch (exit 0); the claim on the card cleared it.
- The dispatch asked to extend existing eval cases where one fits. Cases 12 and 3 are extended, so their prompts changed; the `reference` rule fit no existing case and got a new one.

## Verification

<details><summary>Derived gates at ad8cf055c2: 49 derived, 48 run, 1 NOT MEASURED</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --ran`: "49 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 48 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED (1 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)", exit 0.

- NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, reason: it reads every package's built output and only the closures the skill gates need were built here. CI builds the whole tree.
- Exit 0, among the 48: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `pnpm check:skill-links`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-refs`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-served-sections`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint run check:doc-formula-expressions`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`.

</details>

Read first, by risk:

1. `skills/objectstack-data/rules/field-types.md`, the new sentence under the Relational table: it says `summary` is exempt, which differs from the card's wording.
2. `skills/objectstack-automation/references/state-machines-and-approvals.md`, best practice 2: the rewritten item and the dropped clause.
3. `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`, case 12: an existing prompt gained a sentence.

Two-minute check: run `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and expect exit 0 with the three files at headroom 2, 1 and 0.
